sample_scope: Every source-rate 16 kHz sample is retained, including clip beginnings/endings and 250 ms gaps. No fitted gain/alignment, normalization or sample trimming. The 8 kHz model runs internally at 8 kHz and is upsampled to the source rate for output.
timing_scope: All measured frames, including frontend flush, with no warmup discarded. Neural frame timers exclude initial load/upload and host audio/file operations; steady_audio_rtf includes framing/reconstruction and WAV I/O but excludes one-time loading/initialization. Total elapsed begins after Python imports.
agreement_scope: Waveform error compares each FPGA output against its own pinned CPU model. CPU state is checked each frame; these runs do not read intermediate FPGA state. Error is numerical agreement, not clean-reference speech-quality certification.
